================================================================================
A conditional INSERT ALL
================================================================================

INSERT ALL
  WHEN order_total <= 100000 THEN INTO small_orders
  WHEN order_total > 100000 AND order_total <= 200000 THEN INTO medium_orders
  ELSE INTO large_orders VALUES (order_id, order_total)
SELECT order_id, order_total FROM orders;

---

(source_file
  (insert_statement
    (insert_when_clause
      (binary_expression
        (column_reference
          (identifier))
        (operator)
        (number))
      (insert_into_clause
        (object_reference
          (identifier))))
    (insert_when_clause
      (binary_expression
        (binary_expression
          (column_reference
            (identifier))
          (operator)
          (number))
        (binary_expression
          (column_reference
            (identifier))
          (operator)
          (number)))
      (insert_into_clause
        (object_reference
          (identifier))))
    (insert_into_clause
      (object_reference
        (identifier)))
    (values
      (value_list
        (column_reference
          (identifier))
        (column_reference
          (identifier))))
    (select
      (column_reference
        (identifier))
      (column_reference
        (identifier))
      (from_clause
        (table_reference
          (object_reference
            (identifier)))))))

  WHEN ottl < 200000 THEN INTO medium_orders VALUES (oid, ottl, sid, cid) INTO audit_log VALUES (oid)
SELECT o.order_id oid, o.order_total ottl FROM orders o;

================================================================================
MERGE
================================================================================

MERGE INTO bonuses d
USING (SELECT employee_id, salary, department_id FROM hr.employees WHERE department_id = 80) s
ON (d.employee_id = s.employee_id)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET d.bonus = d.bonus + s.salary * .01
  DELETE WHERE (s.salary > 8000)
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (d.employee_id, d.bonus)
  VALUES (s.employee_id, s.salary * .01)
  WHERE (s.salary <= 8000);

---

(source_file
  (merge_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (identifier)
    (subquery
      (select
        (column_reference
          (identifier))
        (column_reference
          (identifier))
        (column_reference
          (identifier))
        (from_clause
          (table_reference
            (object_reference
              (identifier)
              (identifier))))
        (where_clause
          (binary_expression
            (column_reference
              (identifier))
            (operator)
            (number)))))
    (identifier)
    (parenthesized_expression
      (binary_expression
        (column_reference
          (identifier)
          (identifier))
        (operator)
        (column_reference
          (identifier)
          (identifier))))
    (merge_update_clause
      (assignment
        (column_reference
          (identifier)
          (identifier))
        (binary_expression
          (column_reference
            (identifier)
            (identifier))
          (operator)
          (binary_expression
            (column_reference
              (identifier)
              (identifier))
            (operator)
            (number))))
      (where_clause
        (parenthesized_expression
          (binary_expression
            (column_reference
              (identifier)
              (identifier))
            (operator)
            (number)))))
    (merge_insert_clause
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (values
        (value_list
          (column_reference

MERGE INTO people_target pt USING people_source ps ON (pt.person_id = ps.person_id)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET pt.first_name = ps.first_name WHERE pt.x <> ps.x
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT VALUES (ps.person_id, ps.first_name)
LOG ERRORS INTO err$_people REJECT LIMIT 10;
